full_judgment: 3. The brief facts relevant for the purpose of disposal of the instant Rule are that the predecessor of the petitioners, as plaintiff, instituted Title Suit No. 2 of 1959 in the Court of Munsif, 2nd Court, Pirojpur, now Assistant Judge's Court, Nesarabad, Pirojpur, praying for declaration of Title of the suit land. The plaintiff contended, inter alia, that the suit land measuring 0.01 acre appertaining to CS Khatian No. 261 and CS Plot No. 19 corresponding to RS Plot No.313 recorded in RS Khatian No. 243 and SA Khatian No. 447 of Mouza Kourikhara, PS Nesarabad, District Pirojpur was acquired by the predecessor of the plaintiffs by oral lease in the month of Baishak, 1360 BS. There was a subsequent registered dakhila dated 27-4-54. It is further stated that the RS and SA record of rights having been wrongly prepared in the name of defendant No. 1, who claimed false title to the suit land on 20th Kartick 1365 BS, the predecessor of the petitioners was constrained to file the suit for declaration of title. The said suit was decreed ex parte on 2-6-1959 by the learned Munsif, now Assistant Judge and the plaintiffs title to the suit land was declared. However, the suit land, although it was described correctly in the body and the prayer portion of the plaintiffs plaint, the current Plot No. 313 was wrongly written in schedule "kha" to the plaint as plot No. 331. Hence the petitioners, as heirs of the plaintiff to the earlier suit for declaration, filed the application for correction under section 152 of the Code of Civil Procedure on 27-11-1993. The learned Senior Assistant Judge by his impugned order was pleased to reject the said application on the grounds that the plaintiff has sought correction of the plaint after 35 years from the date of the decree, which is not acceptable in law and is beyond the jurisdiction of his Court. Thus he rejected the application, which is now challenged before this Court.
